# A write to page state reaches every live instance reading it, as the
# interpreter's re-render does: a looped row's text and its `if` follow
# `shown` whether the root wrote it or another instance built at run time
# did, and the row keeps its own `taps`, patched where it stands rather than
# rebuilt. On fyne, gtk4 and html each row is a record of its own, which a
# write elsewhere had no way to, so the rows showed what they read when they
# were built (design/instances.md, *An instance reaches the page through what
# holds it*).
#
# `rec.sngl` is a recursion the build cannot unroll, whose inner frame is an
# instance at a position of its own rather than in a slot's registry: the
# page reaches it by its handle, and it hands the refresh on to what it holds.
#
# `page.sngl` asks the browser for the text, and html's snapshot holds it;
# `app.sngl` and `shown.sngl` snapshot the same rows after a click and built
# showing, which must be one picture on every other target.

mkdir html bubbletea fyne gtk4 android
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html page.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl html/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<span data-sngl-id="line">b true</span>' html/app.sngl.snapshots/toggled.html
grep '>b extra</span>' html/app.sngl.snapshots/toggled.html
cp rec.sngl html/rec.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/rec.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
grep '>level 0!</span>' html/rec.sngl.snapshots/marked.html

cp app.sngl bubbletea/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl bubbletea/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp bubbletea/app.sngl.snapshots/toggled.ansi bubbletea/shown.sngl.snapshots/toggled.ansi
cp rec.sngl bubbletea/rec.sngl
cp rec_marked.sngl bubbletea/rec_marked.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/rec.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/rec_marked.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp bubbletea/rec.sngl.snapshots/marked.ansi bubbletea/rec_marked.sngl.snapshots/marked.ansi

cp app.sngl fyne/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl fyne/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/toggled.png fyne/shown.sngl.snapshots/toggled.png
cp rec.sngl fyne/rec.sngl
cp rec_marked.sngl fyne/rec_marked.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/rec.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/rec_marked.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp fyne/rec.sngl.snapshots/marked.png fyne/rec_marked.sngl.snapshots/marked.png

cp app.sngl gtk4/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl gtk4/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/toggled.png gtk4/shown.sngl.snapshots/toggled.png
cp rec.sngl gtk4/rec.sngl
cp rec_marked.sngl gtk4/rec_marked.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/rec.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/rec_marked.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp gtk4/rec.sngl.snapshots/marked.png gtk4/rec_marked.sngl.snapshots/marked.png

cp app.sngl android/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl android/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android android/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp android/app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/toggled.png android/shown.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/toggled.png
cp rec.sngl android/rec.sngl
cp rec_marked.sngl android/rec_marked.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/rec.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android android/rec_marked.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp android/rec.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/marked.png android/rec_marked.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/marked.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = false
var names = ["a", "b"]

component row(name string) ui.node {
    var taps = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #tap(text="tap {name}", @click {
            taps = taps + 1
        })
        ui.text #line(value="{name} {shown}")
        if shown {
            ui.text #extra(value="{name} extra")
        }
    }
}

component flip ui.node {
    var flips = 0
    ui.button #go(text="flip", @click {
        flips = flips + 1
        shown = !shown
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #toggle(text="toggle", @click {
            shown = !shown
        })
        for var n = names {
            row #rows(name=n)
        }
        for var i = [1] {
            flip #f
        }
    }
}

func testAWriteReachesEveryRow(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.rows[1].tap.click()
    t.assert(c.rows[0].extra == null)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.rows[0].extra != null)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].extra != null)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].taps == 1)
    c.f[0].go.click()
    t.assert(c.rows[0].extra == null)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].extra == null)
    t.assert(c.rows[1].taps == 1)
}

func testToggled(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.toggle.click()
    t.snapshot("toggled")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- shown.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = true
var names = ["a", "b"]

component row(name string) ui.node {

            taps = taps + 1

            ui.text #extra(value="{name} extra")
        }
    }
}

component flip ui.node {
    var flips = 0
    ui.button #go(text="flip", @click {
        flips = flips + 1
        shown = !shown
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #toggle(text="toggle")
        for var n = names {
            row #rows(name=n)
        }
        for var i = [1] {
            flip #f
        }
    }
}

func testToggled(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("toggled")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- page.sngl --
import browser "sngl:test/browser"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = false
var names = ["a", "b"]

component row(name string) ui.node {
    var taps = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #tap(text="tap {name}", @click {
            taps = taps + 1
        })
        ui.text #line(value="{name} {shown}")
    }
}

component flip ui.node {
    var flips = 0
    ui.button #go(text="flip", @click {
        flips = flips + 1
        shown = !shown
    })
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #toggle(text="toggle", @click {
            shown = !shown
        })
        for var n = names {
            row #rows(name=n)
        }
        for var i = [1] {
            flip #f
        }
    }
}

func testTheRowsText(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(browser.text(c.rows[1].line) == "b false")
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(browser.text(c.rows[1].line) == "b true")
    c.f[0].go.click()
    t.assert(browser.text(c.rows[0].line) == "a false")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- rec.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var mark = "*"

component frame(n int) ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="level {n}{mark}")
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #b(text="mark", @click {
            mark = "!"
        })
        frame(n=1)
    }
}

func testMarked(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.b.click()
    t.snapshot("marked")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- rec_marked.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var mark = "!"

component frame(n int) ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="level {n}{mark}")
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #b(text="mark")
        frame(n=1)
    }
}

func testMarked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("marked")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
